units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 27. APPLICATION OF MEASURES SECURING PROCEEDINGS IN ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCE CASES
units.label: Chapter 27. Application of measures securing proceedings in administrative offence cases · “Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation.…”

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. To stop an administrative offence, establish the offender’s identity, draw up an administrative offence record where it cannot be drawn up at the place where the offence was detected, ensure the timely and proper consideration of the administrative offence case and enforcement of the ruling adopted in it, an authorised person may, within their powers, apply the following measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) conveyance to the competent authority;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) administrative detention;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) a personal search, inspection of things and inspection of a vehicle in an individual’s possession; inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity and of things and documents located there;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) seizure of things and documents;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) removal from driving a vehicle of the relevant type;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5.1) examination for alcohol intoxication;
units.label: Point 5.1 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) medical examination for intoxication;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) impoundment of a vehicle;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 8) attachment of goods, vehicles and other things;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 9) compulsory appearance;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 10) temporary prohibition of activity;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 11) security for a vessel under attachment;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 12) placement of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of compulsory expulsion in the special institutions provided for by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-FZ “On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation”;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 13) attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty.
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Harm caused by the unlawful application of measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case shall be compensated in accordance with civil legislation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.label: Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.label: Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 1. Conveyance, meaning the compulsory escort of an individual and, in the cases provided for by points 3, 8 and 10.1 of this part, of a vessel and other instruments used to commit an administrative offence, for the purpose of drawing up an administrative offence record where it cannot be drawn up at the place where the offence was detected and drawing up such a record is mandatory, shall be carried out:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 1) by officials of internal affairs bodies (police), upon detection of administrative offences whose cases are considered by internal affairs bodies (police) under Article 23.3 of this Code, or administrative offences for which internal affairs bodies (police) draw up records under Article 28.3 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offence when requested by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant offences, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or the premises of a local self-government body of a rural settlement;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 2) by military personnel and employees of the federal executive body responsible for matters concerning the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, officials of departmental security services of federal executive bodies, of the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation—the federal city of Moscow—and of organisations entitled to establish departmental security services, and of militarised and guard units of an organisation subordinate to the federal executive body responsible for matters concerning the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences involving damage to or encroachment upon a facility or things under their protection, or entry into a zone under their protection, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police), security service or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 2.1) by officials of departmental security services of federal executive bodies, of the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation—the federal city of Moscow—and of organisations entitled to establish departmental security services, and of militarised and guard units of an organisation subordinate to the federal executive body responsible for matters concerning the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, upon detection of an administrative offence under Article 20.37 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or security service;
units.label: Point 2.1 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 3) by military personnel and employees of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences under Article 7.27 (where directly detected or reported by citizens or organisations), parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 8.37, Article 11.7 (as regards violation of the boundaries of areas closed to navigation or temporarily dangerous for navigation and the rules established for those areas), Article 14.1 (as regards compliance with legislation on weapons, private detective (investigative) activity and private security activity), Article 14.2 (as regards compliance with legislation on weapons), Article 14.15 (as regards violation of the rules for sales of weapons and ammunition), Articles 17.7, 17.9 - 17.13, 18.2 - 18.4, 19.3, 19.7, 19.13, 19.20, 20.1 - 20.3, 20.5, 20.8 - 20.24, parts 1, 2 and 5 of Article 20.25, and Articles 20.30 - 20.32 and 20.34 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police), the official premises of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the premises of a local self-government body of a rural settlement, or other official premises. Vessels and instruments used to commit an administrative offence that are used for unlawful activity in internal sea waters or the territorial sea shall be taken to a port of the Russian Federation (foreign vessels, to a port of the Russian Federation open to foreign vessels) or a specially designated guarded place (a specialised parking area);
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 4) by officials of bodies responsible for supervision or control over compliance with rules for the use of transport, upon detection of administrative offences involving transport, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or other official premises;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 5) by officials of the military motor vehicle inspectorate, upon detection of road traffic rule violations by a driver of a vehicle of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorised to perform civil defence tasks, to the premises of the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or a military unit;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 6) by officials of bodies exercising state environmental supervision, federal state supervision over the protection, reproduction and use of wildlife and its habitats, federal state forest supervision (forest protection), or federal state control (supervision) over fisheries and conservation of aquatic biological resources, upon detection of administrative offences in the relevant field, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police), the premises of a local self-government body of a rural settlement, or other official premises;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 7) by officials of border authorities, military personnel, officials of internal affairs bodies (police) and other persons performing duties to protect the State Border of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences concerning defence and protection of the State Border of the Russian Federation, to the official premises of a border authority, internal affairs body (police) or military unit, or the premises of a local self-government body of a rural settlement;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 8) by officials of border authorities, upon detection of administrative offences in internal sea waters, the territorial sea, the continental shelf or the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation, to the official premises of a border authority, internal affairs body (police) or military unit located in a port of the Russian Federation. Vessels and instruments used to commit an administrative offence that are used for unlawful activity in internal sea waters, the territorial sea, the continental shelf or the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation shall be taken to a port of the Russian Federation (foreign vessels, to a port of the Russian Federation open to foreign vessels);
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 9) repealed. — Federal Law of 30.06.2003 No. 86-FZ;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 10) by officials of customs authorities, upon detection of customs rule violations, to the official premises of a customs authority;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 10.1) by officials of customs authorities, upon detection of customs rule violations in internal sea waters or the territorial sea, to the official premises of a customs authority located in a port of the Russian Federation. Vessels and other instruments used to commit an administrative offence that are used for unlawful activity in internal sea waters or the territorial sea shall be taken to a port of the Russian Federation (foreign vessels, to a port of the Russian Federation open to foreign vessels);
units.label: Point 10.1 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 11) by military personnel and employees of bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system and bodies of the Federal Security Service, upon detection of administrative offences under Articles 19.3 and 19.12 and parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.17 of this Code, to the official premises of an institution of the penal enforcement system, a body of the Federal Security Service or an internal affairs body (police);
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 12) repealed. — Federal Law of 03.07.2016 No. 305-FZ;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 13) by officials conducting a counter-terrorism operation, upon detection of administrative offences under Article 20.27 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or another body conducting the counter-terrorism operation;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 14) by officials of the body authorised to enforce enforcement documents and maintain the established order of court activities, upon detection of administrative offences under Articles 5.35.1, 13.26, 17.3, 17.8, 17.8.1, 17.9, 17.14 and 17.15 and parts 1 and 4 of Article 20.25 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offence committed in a court building (court premises), to the official premises of the court or an internal affairs body (police);
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 15) repealed. — Federal Law of 03.07.2016 No. 305-FZ;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 16) by officials of the federal executive body responsible for state protection, upon detection of administrative offences under Articles 19.3 and 20.17 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police), the premises of a municipal body, or other official premises;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 17) by officials of the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences whose cases are considered by military police bodies of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation under Article 23.88 of this Code, or offences for which officials of the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation draw up records under point 109 of part 2 of Article 28.3 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offences committed by civilian personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation referred to in part 1 of Article 23.88 of this Code, when requested by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant offences, to the official premises of a military police body of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or a military unit;
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 18) by military personnel of the federal executive body responsible for mobilisation preparedness and mobilisation, upon detection of administrative offences under parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.17 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or military unit;
units.label: Point 18 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 19) by military personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences under part 3 of Article 20.17 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or military unit (military police body of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation);
units.label: Point 19 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 20) by officials of internal affairs bodies (police) and border authorities, military personnel and employees of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, and military personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences under Article 20.5.1 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police), the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, a military unit, a state authority or military command body enforcing the martial law regime, the premises of a local self-government body of a rural settlement, or other official premises.
units.label: Point 20 Part 1 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 2. Conveyance shall be carried out within the shortest possible time.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
units.text: 3. A record of conveyance shall be drawn up, or a corresponding entry made in the administrative offence record or administrative detention record. A copy of the conveyance record shall be given to the person conveyed upon request.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.2

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.label: Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.label: Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 1. Administrative detention, meaning a short-term restriction of an individual’s liberty, may be applied in exceptional cases where necessary to ensure proper and timely consideration of an administrative offence case or enforcement of the ruling in the case. Administrative detention may be carried out by:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 1) officials of internal affairs bodies (police), upon detection of administrative offences whose cases are considered by internal affairs bodies (police) under Article 23.3 of this Code, or administrative offences for which internal affairs bodies (police) draw up records under Article 28.3 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offence when requested by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant offences;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 2) the senior officials at the sites of protected facilities of departmental security services of federal executive bodies, of the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation—the federal city of Moscow—and of organisations entitled to establish departmental security services, and of militarised and guard units of an organisation subordinate to the federal executive body responsible for matters concerning the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, and military personnel and employees of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences involving damage to or encroachment upon a facility or things under their protection, or entry into a zone under their protection;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 2.1) the senior officials at the sites of protected facilities of departmental security services of federal executive bodies, of the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation—the federal city of Moscow—and of organisations entitled to establish departmental security services, and of militarised and guard units of an organisation subordinate to the federal executive body responsible for matters concerning the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, upon detection of an administrative offence under Article 20.37 of this Code;
units.label: Point 2.1 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 3) officials of the military motor vehicle inspectorate, upon detection of road traffic rule violations by a driver of a vehicle of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorised to perform civil defence tasks;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 4) officials of border authorities and internal affairs bodies (police), upon detection of administrative offences concerning defence and protection of the State Border of the Russian Federation or administrative offences in internal sea waters, the territorial sea, the continental shelf or the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 5) repealed. — Federal Law of 30.06.2003 No. 86-FZ;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 6) officials of customs authorities, upon detection of customs rule violations;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 7) military personnel and officials of bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system and bodies of the Federal Security Service, upon detection of administrative offences under Articles 19.3 and 19.12 of this Code and administrative offences involving damage to or encroachment upon a facility or things under their protection, or entry into a zone under their protection;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 8) repealed. — Federal Law of 03.07.2016 No. 305-FZ;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 9) officials conducting a counter-terrorism operation, upon detection of administrative offences under Article 20.27 of this Code;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 10) officials of the body authorised to enforce enforcement documents and maintain the established order of court activities, upon detection of administrative offences under Articles 5.35.1, 13.26, 17.3, 17.8, 17.8.1, 17.9, 17.14 and 17.15 and parts 1 and 4 of Article 20.25 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offences committed in a court building (court premises);
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 11) officials of the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences whose cases are considered by military police bodies of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation under Article 23.88 of this Code, or offences for which officials of the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation draw up records under point 109 of part 2 of Article 28.3 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offences committed by civilian personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation referred to in part 1 of Article 23.88 of this Code, when requested by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant offences;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 12) military personnel of the federal executive body responsible for mobilisation preparedness and mobilisation, upon detection of administrative offences under parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.17 of this Code;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 13) military personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences under part 3 of Article 20.17 of this Code;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 27.3
